description: This Swift source file defines data structures, enums, and parsing logic for handling deep links in an app, including agent and gateway deep links, as well as parsing URL schemes specific to 'openclaw'. It provides mechanisms to create, parse, and validate deep link URLs, including base64 decoding and JSON parsing.

methods.name: websocketURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL for WebSocket connection based on TLS setting.

methods.name: fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON setup code string to create a GatewayConnectDeepLink object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL with 'openclaw' scheme to determine if it is an agent or gateway deep link.
